name: VESC Autonomous Motor Engineering Plugin
description: Autonomous motor engineering, FOC tuning, aerospace safety auditing, dynamic evaluation, and continuous learning harness for VESC motor controllers across arbitrary BLDC/PMSM motors and power tiers.
author: PS1Lab CT-2W1 eVTOL Propulsion Systems Team

safety_invariants.description: foc_sensor_mode=3 (HFI) is strictly prohibited on surface permanent magnet (SPM) outrunners.
l_in_current_min >= 0.0A prevents reverse regenerative charging into unidirectional DC power supplies.
l_max_duty must be physically clamped based on V_bus and Kv to prevent bare-motor high throttle runaway.
l_min_erpm = 0.0 enforces unidirectional forward rotation for fixed-pitch propellers.
timeout_msec <= 300 enforces communication loss failsafe cutoff.
s_pid_kd = 0.0 prevents observer PLL noise amplification and high-frequency chattering.

tools.name: vesc_calculate_config
tools.description: Calculates optimal VESC FOC parameters, current limits, and anti-runaway duty clamps for a given motor specification.

tools.name: vesc_validate_config
tools.description: Audits a VESC configuration against strict physical and aerospace safety invariants.

tools.name: vesc_run_eval_suite
tools.description: Executes full aerospace verification test suite on High-Fidelity Mock Simulator or Live Hardware.

tools.name: vesc_get_learning_history
tools.description: Retrieves statistical benchmarks, regression alerts, and tuning recommendations from the continuous learning loop.

tools.name: vesc_export_xml
tools.description: Exports a VESC profile to VESC Tool MCConfiguration and APPConfiguration XML format.
